title: Disable Xbox Game Bar and background recording
description: Turns off Game Bar and Game DVR capture, which use GPU time and can cause stutter.
details:
HKCU\System\GameConfigStore: GameDVR_Enabled = 0
HKCU\...\CurrentVersion\GameDVR: AppCaptureEnabled = 0
HKCU\Software\Microsoft\GameBar: UseNexusForGameBarEnabled = 0
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR: AllowGameDVR = 0

title: High-performance power plan
description: Creates and activates the "MyTune Performance" plan: no core parking, no CPU throttling, USB and PCIe power saving off, never sleeps on AC.
details:
Creates power plan 8e3f2a71-5c1b-4d7e-9a2f-6d795475e001 (a copy of High performance with tuned processor, USB, PCIe and sleep settings) and makes it active.
Your previous plan is remembered and restored when you turn this off.
Laptops get a battery-friendly variant that keeps sleep and hibernate.

title: NVIDIA low-latency profile
description: Sets the global NVIDIA driver profile for maximum performance and minimum input lag.
details:
NVIDIA Base Profile:
• Power management: prefer maximum performance
• Low latency mode: on (1 pre-rendered frame)
• Vertical sync: off
• Triple buffering: off
• Preferred refresh rate: highest available
• Texture filtering quality: high performance
• Trilinear optimization: on
• Anisotropic filter optimization: on
• Anisotropic sample optimization: on
• Shader cache size: unlimited
• FXAA: off
• Ansel: off (older drivers only)
• Anisotropic filtering: off
• Antialiasing transparency: off
• OpenGL GDI compatibility: prefer performance
G-SYNC and per-game profiles you set yourself are not touched.

title: Disable Microsoft telemetry
description: Limits diagnostic data to the minimum and stops the telemetry services.
details:
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection: AllowTelemetry = 0
Services DiagTrack and dmwappushservice: Disabled

title: Best-performance visual effects
description: Turns off Windows animations and visual effects. Font smoothing stays on.
details:
HKCU\...\Explorer\VisualEffects: VisualFXSetting = 2
HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop: UserPreferencesMask = 90 12 03 80 10 00 00 00
HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics: MinAnimate = 0
HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced: TaskbarAnimations = 0

title: Disable automatic Windows Update
description: Stops Windows from downloading and installing updates on its own. You can still update manually in Settings.

title: Disable automatic Microsoft Store updates
description: Stops Store apps from updating in the background while you play.

title: 0.5 ms timer resolution while gaming
description: Raises the Windows timer resolution while a Game Hub game is running, for smoother frame pacing. Works while MyTune is running (it keeps running in the tray).
details:
Calls NtSetTimerResolution(0.5 ms) when a game from Game Hub starts and releases it when the last one closes.
HKLM\...\Session Manager\kernel: GlobalTimerResolutionRequests = 1 (so Windows 11 honours it while MyTune is in the tray)

title: Disable background apps
description: Stops Store apps from running in the background.

title: Disable Copilot and Recall
description: Turns off Windows Copilot, its taskbar button and Recall snapshots, which run in the background.
details:
HKLM + HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot: TurnOffWindowsCopilot = 1
HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced: ShowCopilotButton = 0
HKLM + HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI: DisableAIDataAnalysis = 1
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI: AllowRecallEnablement = 0

title: Disable Storage Sense
description: Stops Windows from cleaning up files automatically in the background.

title: Disable notification center and calendar
description: Removes the notification center and calendar flyout from the taskbar. Explorer restarts.

title: Disable hibernation and Fast Startup
description: Removes hiberfil.sys (frees several GB) and makes every shutdown a clean one.
details:
Runs: powercfg /hibernate off
Turning it back on runs: powercfg /hibernate on

title: Classic right-click menu
description: Brings back the full Windows 10 right-click menu without "Show more options". Explorer restarts.
details: Creates HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32 with an empty default value.

title: Microsoft Edge debloat
description: Stops Edge running in the background and turns off its sidebar, shopping and recommendation pop-ups.
details: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge: StartupBoostEnabled = 0, BackgroundModeEnabled = 0, HubsSidebarEnabled = 0, EdgeShoppingAssistantEnabled = 0, ShowRecommendationsEnabled = 0, PersonalizationReportingEnabled = 0, UserFeedbackAllowed = 0, DiagnosticData = 0

title: Brave debloat
description: Turns off Brave Rewards, Wallet, VPN and AI Chat.

title: Optimizations for windowed games
description: Lets borderless and windowed games use the faster flip presentation path (lower latency), close to exclusive fullscreen.
details: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences: DirectXUserGlobalSettings gets SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1; (other entries in that value are kept)

title: Turn off multiplane overlay
description: Disables MPO, a known cause of stutter, flicker and black screens in some games on NVIDIA and AMD drivers.

title: Turn off hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
description: Some games have smoother frame pacing with HAGS off. Others need it on (DLSS Frame Generation does).

title: MSI mode for GPU and network adapter
description: Switches your graphics card and network adapter to message-signaled interrupts, which can lower DPC latency. Many drivers already use MSI.
details:
For each PCI graphics and network device, HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\<device>\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties: MSISupported = 1
Original values are restored when you turn this off.

title: Disable Virtualization-Based Security
description: Turns off VBS, Memory Integrity and the hypervisor for more FPS. This lowers protection against malware, and Valorant (Vanguard) and some anti-cheats need VBS on.
details:
HKLM\...\DeviceGuard: EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity = 0
HKLM\...\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity: Enabled = 0
bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype off (previous value is remembered)

title: Adapter power management off
description: Keeps your network adapter at full power instead of letting it sleep. The connection drops for a few seconds when applied.
details: Driver settings (only those your adapter has): *DeviceSleepOnDisconnect, *SelectiveSuspend, ReduceSpeedOnPowerDown, ULPMode = 0

title: Adapter latency tuning
description: Turns off interrupt moderation, flow control and Energy-Efficient Ethernet. The connection drops for a few seconds when applied.
details: Driver settings (only those your adapter has): *InterruptModeration, *FlowControl, *EEE, EEELinkAdvertisement, AdvancedEEE, EnableGreenEthernet, GreenEthernet = 0

title: Unbind unused protocols
description: Turns off network discovery protocols (LLTD and LLDP) that games never use.
details:
Disable-NetAdapterBinding for ms_lltdio, ms_rspndr and ms_lldp on each connected adapter.
File and printer sharing stay on.

title: Disable advertising ID
description: Stops apps from using a personal advertising ID to track you across apps.

title: Remove ads, suggestions and auto-installed apps
description: Turns off Start menu and lock screen ads, Settings suggestions, Windows Spotlight tips and the sponsored apps Windows installs on its own.
details:
HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager: ContentDeliveryAllowed, SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled, SilentInstalledAppsEnabled, PreInstalledAppsEnabled, OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled, SoftLandingEnabled, RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled, SubscribedContent-* = 0
HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent: DisableWindowsSpotlightFeatures = 1
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent: DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures = 1

title: Turn off activity history and Timeline
description: Stops Windows from recording which apps and files you open and uploading it to Microsoft.

title: Turn off tailored experiences and inking data
description: Stops Windows from using your diagnostic data for tips and ads, and from collecting what you type and write.

title: Stop feedback prompts
description: Windows stops asking you for feedback.

title: Turn off location services
description: Windows and apps can no longer see where you are. Maps, weather and "find my device" will not know your location.

title: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
description: Crash reports are no longer collected and sent to Microsoft, and the reporting dialog no longer appears.

title: Disable telemetry scheduled tasks
description: Turns off the background tasks that collect and send usage data (Compatibility Appraiser, Customer Experience program, feedback).
details:
Disables these tasks (only those that exist), and re-enables only the ones MyTune disabled:
\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater
\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator, UsbCeip
\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy
\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient, DmClientOnScenarioDownload
\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\QueueReporting

title: Xbox services to Manual
description: Xbox Live, game save sync and accessory services only start when something needs them. Games that sign in to Xbox Live still work.
details: Services XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxGipSvc, XboxNetApiSvc: Automatic → Manual (never Disabled). Only those currently set to Automatic are changed.

title: Print Spooler to Manual
description: Printing service starts only when you print. Do not use this if you print a lot and want it ready instantly.
details: Service Spooler: Automatic → Manual (never Disabled). Your previous start type is restored when you turn this off.

title: Disable OneDrive
description: Stops OneDrive from syncing and starting with Windows. Does not uninstall it or delete your files, and you can turn it back on here.

title: Remove Teams chat icon
description: Removes the Chat (Teams) button from the taskbar. Explorer restarts.

title: Disable Microsoft Store (aggressive)
description: Blocks the Store app entirely. Store and Xbox app games cannot be installed or updated while this is on. Revert to get it back.

title: Activate G-SYNC
description: Keeps G-SYNC / variable refresh enabled in the NVIDIA driver. It is usually already on. Turn it off only if your fps stays far above your refresh rate and you accept screen tearing for slightly lower latency (competitive play).
details: NVIDIA driver, global Base Profile: Enable G-SYNC globally, Toggle the VRR global feature, VRR requested state. On = NVIDIA's defaults (enabled). Off = all three set to 0.

title: Variable refresh rate for windowed games
description: G-SYNC and FreeSync also work in borderless and windowed games, not just exclusive fullscreen. Needs a variable-refresh monitor.
details: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences: DirectXUserGlobalSettings gets VRROptimizeEnable=1; (other entries in that value are kept)

title: Auto HDR
description: Windows adds HDR to supported DirectX 11 and 12 games that were made for standard range. Needs an HDR display with HDR turned on in Windows.
details: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences: DirectXUserGlobalSettings gets AutoHDREnable=2097; (other entries in that value are kept)

title: Turn off Delivery Optimization
description: Stops your PC from sharing Windows update files with other PCs over your internet connection.

title: Keep Windows Update away from drivers
description: Windows Update no longer replaces your graphics driver with its own version. Update drivers yourself from NVIDIA, AMD or Intel.

title: No automatic restarts after updates
description: Windows will not restart by itself while you are signed in (for example in the middle of a game).

title: Faster shutdown
description: Closes hung apps and services after 2 seconds instead of waiting 5 to 20 seconds. Unsaved data in a frozen app is lost sooner.
details:
HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop: WaitToKillAppTimeout = 2000, HungAppTimeout = 2000, AutoEndTasks = 1
HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control: WaitToKillServiceTimeout = 2000

title: Instant menus
description: Menus open with no delay.

title: Remove startup app delay
description: Windows starts your startup apps right away instead of waiting about 10 seconds after sign-in.

title: Turn off USB selective suspend
description: Stops Windows from powering down USB devices (mouse, keyboard, headset) to save energy, which can cause a short lag when they wake. Your USB ports are not disabled: they stay on and keep working, only the power-saving sleep is turned off.

title: Faster keyboard response
description: Shortens the delay before a held key starts repeating.

title: Enable long file paths
description: Lets apps and mods use file paths longer than 260 characters.

title: Open File Explorer to This PC
description: Explorer opens to your drives instead of Home with recent files.

title: Remove Home and Gallery from Explorer
description: Takes the Home and Gallery entries out of the Explorer sidebar. Explorer restarts.

title: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
description: The clock shows seconds. Explorer restarts.

title: Turn off search highlights
description: Removes the daily doodles and trending pictures from the search box.

title: Stop accessibility key pop-ups
description: Pressing Shift five times, holding Shift or holding Num Lock no longer opens Sticky Keys, Filter Keys or Toggle Keys prompts while you play.
details:
HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys: Flags = 506
HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response: Flags = 122
HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys: Flags = 58

title: Faster hover tooltips
description: Tooltips and taskbar previews appear sooner.

title: Tidy the right-click menu
description: Removes Share, Give access to and Include in library from the right-click menu. Explorer restarts.
details: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Shell Extensions\Blocked: adds {E2BF9676-5F8F-435C-97EB-11607A5BEDF7} (Share), {F81E9010-6EA4-11CE-A7FF-00AA003CA9F6} (Give access to), {3DAD6C5D-2167-4CAE-9914-F99E41C12CFA} (Include in library)

title: Add "Take ownership" to the right-click menu
description: Adds a right-click entry on files and folders that makes you the owner and gives administrators full access. Handy for locked game or mod files.
details:
Creates HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\*\shell\MyTuneTakeOwnership and HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Directory\shell\MyTuneTakeOwnership, running takeown and icacls /grant Administrators:F.
Both keys are removed when you turn this off.

title: Dark theme
description: Dark mode for Windows and apps.

title: Outline when moving windows
description: Shows only a frame while you drag or resize a window, instead of moving the whole window. Lighter on the GPU.

title: Turn off web results in Start search
description: Searching from Start only shows your PC, with no Bing web results. Explorer restarts.

title: Hide Start menu recommendations
description: Removes recently added apps, files and tips from Start. Explorer restarts.

title: Align taskbar icons to the left
description: Moves the taskbar icons and Start button to the left like Windows 10.

title: Hide the taskbar search button
description: Removes the search box or icon from the taskbar. Search still opens with the Windows key.

title: Hide the Task View button
description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar. Win + Tab still works.

title: Show file extensions
description: Shows .exe, .txt and other extensions in File Explorer.

title: Show hidden files and folders
description: Shows hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

title: Turn off window snapping
description: Dragging a window to a screen edge no longer arranges it. Applies after you sign out.

title: Turn off the snap layout flyout
description: Hovering the maximize button no longer shows layout suggestions.

title: Turn off snap assist suggestions
description: After snapping a window, Windows no longer suggests other windows to fill the rest of the screen.

title: NumLock on at startup
description: Turns NumLock on at the sign-in screen and after sign-in.

title: Verbose sign-in messages
description: Shows what Windows is doing during startup, sign-in and shutdown.

title: Detailed crash screen
description: Shows technical error details on the blue screen.

title: Hide the Settings home page
description: Opens Settings on System instead of the Home page with suggestions.
